title: S70 — PREREGISTERED probe: image-side case instrument v1 (x-height / cap-ratio)
desc: PREREGISTERED BOUNDED PROBE. GOAL: an image-side case instrument (e.g., x-height / cap-height ratio features + token context rules) for the 9 case-only hard misses (4 are stitch): decide case where every character is already recovered. WHY: S55 §6: the 9 case items await an image-side instrument that beats the S24 gate; S55 §7 screening showed text-side case priors are catastrophic (D: 1 fix vs 21+67 breaks) — so this must be image-side and abstain on ties. READ FIRST: reports/s43_failure_analysis.md (case lane), reports/s55-postprocess-audit.md §2-§3+§7, the S24 case probe reports. PROTOCOL: publish your preregistration (hypothesis, features, dev seed, held-out seeds, exact bar) BEFORE looking at held-out results. Minimum gate (the S55 gate): canonical seed-1 gain, zero regressions, seed-2 non-negative; ties must abstain. EVIDENCE: reports/case-instrument/prereg.md then result.md (+receipts) + PUSHES rows + formalcode lines. BOUNDARIES: probe only — no shipping edits without review; NO-GO gets published too. Boundaries: no edits to shipping paths unless the task says so; no tuning on canonical seeds 1/2/3/4/53 (evaluation only); honest numbers — no 98/95 claims; captchaproject(s) off-limits.
